SELECT COUNT(*) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) AS totalAmount, COALESCE(SUM(discount_amount), 0) AS discountAmount, COALESCE(SUM(pay_amount), 0) AS payAmount FROM pos_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND DATE(create_time) = #{date}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) AS totalAmount, COALESCE(SUM(discount_amount), 0) AS discountAmount, COALESCE(SUM(pay_amount), 0) AS payAmount FROM pos_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND create_time >= #{startDate} AND create_time <= #{endDate}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) AS totalAmount, COALESCE(SUM(discount_amount), 0) AS discountAmount, COALESCE(SUM(pay_amount), 0) AS payAmount FROM pos_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') = #{yearMonth}
